missed.why: P2 dropped it on a jlcparts stand-off of 5.0 V and did not read its datasheet. The datasheet (SLLS685D, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tpd6e001.pdf, SHA-256 2ac09d1a40497e97f41381a62d979bd68bced7105db31e6b8316e263d317af05, read 2026-10-01T21:49:17Z) gives: 6 channels; IEC 61000-4-2 +/-8 kV contact and +/-15 kV air (section 6.2), so V9 passes without the owner's relaxation, unlike TPD6E004's +/-12 kV air; Ci/o 1.5 pF typ (V11 <= 75 pF); channel leakage +/-1 nA; -40 to 85 C (V7); breakdown 11 V min. Section 8.2.2 step 5b: with VCC left unconnected it 'can tolerate higher signal swing in the range up to 10 V', which covers VBUS 5.5 V (V10) and CC at vRd, and with no supply tied to VBUS CC is not pulled toward an unpowered VBUS. TPD6E004 states only 5.8 V for the same case. Same layout condition as P2's rank 2: VCC pin open with the 0.1 uF bypass the datasheet recommends. Not shown or weaker: Table 6.1 gives VI/O max VCC + 0.3 V with no condition for open VCC; no capacitance-matching figure (D+ and D- 10 %); clamp at 8 kV contact is VCC + 60 V positive (not production tested) against V12's 36 V at 16 A, which the owner's relaxation of 2026-09-30 lets stand; package QFN-12-EP 4 x 4 mm. Rule 4: JLCPCB C1975428 stockCount 193, canPresaleNumber 193, expand (vendors.py jlcpcb, 2026-10-01T21:49:12Z), at or above the gate of 50. Rule 5 and Digi-Key: TPD6E001RSFR stock_available 2000, Active, lead time 12 weeks (vendors.py digikey, 2026-10-01T21:56:03Z). Lifecycle: TI product page https://www.ti.com/product/TPD6E001 meta status ACTIVE (2026-10-01T21:58:22Z). Ranks above TPD6E004RSER on V9 and the open-VCC swing, below TPD6E05U06RVZR on clamping and size.

Same die and datasheet as TPD6E001RSFR (read 2026-10-01T21:49:17Z) in UQFN-10 1.5 x 2 mm; every value as for RSFR, including the open-VCC condition. Rule 4: JLCPCB C1973318 stockCount 1032, canPresaleNumber 1027, expand (2026-10-01T21:49:12Z). Digi-Key TPD6E001RSER: Active, lead time 20 weeks, stock_available 0 (vendors.py digikey, 2026-10-01T21:55:54Z), so Digi-Key does not give rule 5 for this package. The RSFR is not pin-compatible (QFN-12 4 x 4 mm), so it is not an alternate in the same land pattern. Second source open for this package; the smaller package is the reason to list it. TI status ACTIVE as for RSFR.
